source: Original 1647 William Lilly Christian Astrology, Wellcome Collection b30338724
heading: Of the Mother
source_scope: Historical mother health, status, ancestry and alleged mortality source clauses, never medical or person-level prediction.

groups.group: Original printed CXXII mother heading and four significator sources

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXII Of the Mother
claims.historical_only_meaning: The printed original mother chapter begins under a divider on PDF604, distinct from unnumbered fourth-house father source.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: first, the tenth house
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly assigns the tenth house as a primary mother significator, differing from fourth house for father.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: secondly, the Lord thereof
claims.historical_only_meaning: The tenth house ruler is a separate maternal significator, not the house itself.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Venus in a diurnall Nativity
claims.historical_only_meaning: In daylight genitures Venus receives a mother significator role; the sect qualification is essential.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon in a nocturnall
claims.historical_only_meaning: In nighttime genitures Moon is an alternate natal mother significator to daylight Venus.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Planet or Planets in the tenth house
claims.historical_only_meaning: Any planet(s) occupying the tenth house are additional mother-source candidates.

groups.group: Majority strengthened mother significators and family baseline

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: All or the major part ... well constituted in Figure
claims.historical_only_meaning: The favorable branch requires all or most mother indicators in a strong natal condition, not merely one.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in good houses or essentially dignified
claims.historical_only_meaning: House placement and essential dignity are separate criteria that can support this branch.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: presageth good unto the Mother
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly alleges maternal favorable fate from the compound conditions, not verified outcomes.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: quality of the Family from whence she is derived
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author's favorable judgment is explicitly relative to preexisting maternal family background, a strong non-astrological control.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: after the Birth of the Child
claims.historical_only_meaning: The claimed favorable maternal status is scoped to after the child's birth, not all life before and after indiscriminately.

groups.group: Afflicted maternal significators versus father mother relative baseline

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators especially Moon extremely afflicted
claims.historical_only_meaning: Highly afflicted mother indicators, particularly Moon, form the explicit negative branch.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: much misery or Sickness unto the Mother
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author alleges illness and unhappiness, with no medical records or clinical validation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: many inconveniences and distractions
claims.historical_only_meaning: Inconvenience/disruption is a second claimed adverse outcome, not identical to diagnosed disease.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: examining the Significators both of Father and Mother
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly compares the two sets of parental indicators, not mother indicators alone, to rank their fortunes.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Goods of Fortune, Body or Mind
claims.historical_only_meaning: The comparison covers prosperity, bodily condition and mental condition, distinct outcomes that should not be pooled.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: whose Significators are best fortified ... most happy
claims.historical_only_meaning: He proposes selecting whichever parent has stronger indicators as comparatively more fortunate.

groups.group: Benefic versus malefic sources and historic quality/health domain

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter or Venus ... what may advance either Parent
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly attributes paternal/maternal advantages to Jupiter/Venus and their houses as a traditional interpretation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn or Mars ... what may prejudice them
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author gives Saturn/Mars and their houses as claimed sources of parental troubles.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars afflicting Significators ... Martiall men or things
claims.historical_only_meaning: An afflicted source planet Mars is interpreted as harm from a Mars-associated person/thing, not a verified cause.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: if Saturn then Saturnine
claims.historical_only_meaning: Saturn affliction is assigned analogous Saturn-associated matters, reinforcing speculative taxonomic flexibility.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: respect the house as aforesaid
claims.historical_only_meaning: He instructs considering house position in classifying parental help/harm; the potential interpretation combinations are numerous.

groups.group: Oriental and occidental maternal planets / infortunes

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Orientality and Occidentality of Moon and Venus
claims.historical_only_meaning: The source adds oriental/occidental status of mother signifier planets to its interpretation procedure.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Orientall ... more hurt the Life
claims.historical_only_meaning: An oriental-status configuration is connected with purported greater threat to life; exact grammatical subject requires audit.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Occidentall ... the Estate
claims.historical_only_meaning: An occidental alternative is connected to estate/wealth harms rather than survival; exact scope uncertain.

groups.group: Mother healthy/happy positive tenth house or conjunction condition

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon or Venus in the tenth
claims.historical_only_meaning: Moon or Venus in tenth house is a first favorable maternal-health condition, not sufficient alone.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in good aspect with Jupiter
claims.historical_only_meaning: Favorable aspect to Jupiter is an additional required or supportive condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mother her Health and happy state
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author asserts maternal health and good state under this pattern; not independent clinical proof.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon or Venus in conjunction with Saturn Mars or Mercury
claims.historical_only_meaning: A conjunction with named planets is given as a negative mother-life pattern, with operator scope uncertain.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in the tenth or fourth
claims.historical_only_meaning: The preceding negative conjunction must occur in tenth or fourth in the printed clause.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: she will not live long
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly alleges shortened lifespan without numerical or observational basis; strictly archival not predictive.

groups.group: Fortified Moon and supporting Venus/Jupiter conditions alleged long maternal life

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon fortunate in own house or Exaltation
claims.historical_only_meaning: The first favorable maternal longevity condition is the Moon in domicile or exaltation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in an angle or succedant house
claims.historical_only_meaning: The Moon must also occupy an angular or succedent place in that pattern.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: assisted by Venus Sextile or Trine
claims.historical_only_meaning: The source adds Venus in sextile or trine as a qualifying supporter, not Venus merely present.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or else Jupiter doe aspect her
claims.historical_only_meaning: Jupiter aspecting Moon is an alternative to Venus sextile/trine in the original grammar.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mother is like to live long and happily
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author predicts maternal longevity/wellbeing, not verified lifespan outcomes.

groups.group: Two low-status houses mother servant stereotype

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon and Venus in abject places of the Figure
claims.historical_only_meaning: Both Moon and Venus in distressed houses are included as a historical low-status branch.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: one in the twelfth the other in the sixth
claims.historical_only_meaning: The source specifically gives opposite placements of Moon/Venus in twelfth/sixth as an example.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mother to have been a servant
claims.historical_only_meaning: The source alleges a mother's occupational status from placements; not evidence about social class.

groups.group: Saturn/Mars harms, motion-speed and Moon orientations

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn or Mars afflicting Moon by Square or Opposition
claims.historical_only_meaning: Square or opposition from either Saturn/Mars to Moon is a negative maternal health testimony.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: also slow in motion removed from angles
claims.historical_only_meaning: Slow motion and angular distance are added as qualifications; exact grammatical reference uncertain.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: shew a sickly Mother
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author connects those aspects to presumed chronic maternal sickness; unverified clinical claim.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon and they swift in motion
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly further mentions rapid motion in another negative lifespan configuration; conditions should not be silently merged.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon or Venus in first tenth second or eleventh
claims.historical_only_meaning: A listing of angular/succedent houses appears in another maternal-short-life condition with unresolved operator scope.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: they shorten the Mothers life
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author alleges shorter maternal life; no birth/disease/death data.

groups.group: Specific oriental vs occidental illnesses and premodern organs

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon Orientall afflicted of Saturn
claims.historical_only_meaning: Moon oriental and Saturn-afflicted is named as a special negative medical condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Feavers Agues Trembling or great Feares
claims.historical_only_meaning: The source alleges fevers/trembling/fears; these are 1647 descriptions, not diagnoses.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon Occidentall and so afflicted
claims.historical_only_meaning: Occidental Moon afflicted is the corresponding different negative disease condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: many Diseases ... imposthumation in Matrix Reines
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author claims certain abscesses or organ conditions under this pattern; this is archaic and medically unsupported.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon in Opposition of Saturn
claims.historical_only_meaning: A separate Moon-Saturn opposition is provided near the chapter end for illness.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: continual Sickness and the Chollick
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly alleges lingering illness/colic from opposition; no actual human medical validity.

groups.group: Following CXXIII on childbirth difficulty, navigation only

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXIII If the Mother had difficult Travell
claims.historical_only_meaning: Printed CXXIII begins top PDF606 and concerns childbirth difficulty, a separate natal question.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Signes of oblique ascentions in the ascendant
claims.historical_only_meaning: Only the incipit of the next maternal childbirth question is witnessed; its childbirth rules not included here.
